ready.text: Aegis reporting. The line will hold.

select.text: Give us a clear firing lane.
They have not seen us yet.

ready.text: Nyx is in the field. Stay connected.

select.text: Plenty of life in this old rig.

gather.text: Let us see what we can salvage.

select.text: Ridge ranger. Got eyes on the trail.
Wind is clear. What is the call?
Got a rocket with their name on it.
Just point out the big one.

attack.text: Let us crack that tin can!

select.text: Pathfinder Rook. I know a way.
We did not come this far to quit.

attack.text: Let us give them a reason to leave.

ready.text: Rook is here. Let us bring everyone home.

select.text: Kestrel here. Good day to fly.
Rotor is steady. Sky is ours.
Rescue pilot here. Who needs a lift?

attack.text: Taking us out of the crossfire.
